minutes.headline: School withdrew its special town meeting AC article after bids far exceeded funds; board favored condensed APDC article.
minutes.summary: The Select Board ratified two police appointments, approved a Boys and Girls Club haunted house, and reviewed special town meeting warrant articles. The school department withdrew its primary school air conditioning article after quotes came in far above the approved funds. The board also heard a joint presentation of municipal building concepts and discussed a petition to move town meeting to April.

what_happened.line: The school department withdrew its primary school air conditioning article for the special town meeting after bids came in far above the money approved earlier.
A majority of the Select Board indicated support for the condensed APDC bylaw article, with an updated version expected next week.
The board voted to ratify two police appointments, one full-time officer and one reserve officer, both effective October 12, 2022.
The board recommended approval of the Personnel Committee's salary administration plan article unanimously, and approved a Boys and Girls Club haunted house with one abstention.
The town manager is to ask the town clerk about the effect of moving town meeting to April, in response to a petition, before next week.

why_it_matters: With the air conditioning article withdrawn, the primary school cooling project has no funding path on this special town meeting warrant, so the money approved earlier does not cover the bids received.
The salary plan, the APDC bylaw and the possible move of town meeting to April are items residents may be asked to vote on at town meeting.
watch_next: An updated condensed APDC article, expected at the next Select Board meeting.
The town clerk's answer on moving town meeting to April, due before next week's meeting.
